pack.name: AI Recipes: Repo Ops
pack.description: Automations that work on a repo you name: a pull-request review pass and one small additive enhancement to a static app, both report-only unless you turn the side effects on.

templates.name: AI Recipe: App Enhancement
templates.description: Claude ships one small additive enhancement to one static web app in a folder you name (the least-enhanced app each run): a filter, a shortcut, an export, an empty state, an accessibility fix. It edits a copy, the runner diffs it into a patch and checks the page still loads clean; the patch is only applied to your app when you say so.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: Apps folder
parameters.help: A folder whose subfolders are static web apps, each with an index.html. The run picks the one with the fewest enhancements so far.

parameters.label: Apply the patch to the app
parameters.help: no publishes enhancement.md and enhancement.patch and leaves your app untouched. yes also writes the changed files back into the app folder after the run passes every check.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

templates.author: ai-automation-tools

templates.name: AI Recipe: PR Review
templates.description: Claude reviews every open pull request in one GitHub repo against a fixed set of gates (red or pending checks, conflicts, secrets, infra files, destructive migrations, unrelated changes, human markers) and writes a verdict per PR. Report mode is read-only; comment mode posts one comment per PR; merge mode squash-merges the ones that pass and holds the rest.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: GitHub repository
parameters.help: owner/name of the repository to review. The GitHub CLI (gh) must be installed and logged in to an account that can read it, and write to it for comment or merge mode.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.help: report only writes the review. comment also posts one comment per PR. merge also squash-merges every PR that passes every gate and leaves a hold comment on the rest.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.
